objective: Provide a platform-owned, read-only commercial evaluation control plane that derives bounded operational metrics from verified TaskContext event chains and immutable EvaluationRecords without converting missing telemetry into false success or project-global failure.
mustPreserve: TaskContextRuntime remains the authority for event-chain, EvaluationRecord, Receipt, GoalRevision, AcceptanceProfile, sourceScope, and completion identities
commercial aggregation is read-only and never mutates task or context lifecycle
metrics are cohort-scoped and never project a task failure into project-global P0
missing cost, correction, claim-audit, or regression telemetry produces evidence-pending with a null value rather than zero
humanCorrectionRate closes only from platform-reverified task-bound Codex transcript slices and never from candidate counts or whole-session projection
Static, Runtime, and Release evidence remain independent
Automation Accepted and Blocked remain transport statuses and are never used as TaskContext outcomes
all source EvaluationRecords and event chains are re-read and integrity-verified before aggregation
same verified source snapshot produces the same snapshotHash and metric values
allowedTransitions: verified TaskContext observations -> deterministic cohort snapshot -> CommercialEvaluationReport
evidence-pending metric -> closed metric only after its registered authoritative source becomes available
new immutable task evidence -> new snapshotHash and report identity
forbiddenTransitions: Automation run status -> commercial success or failure
static report -> Runtime or Release acceptance
commercial report generation -> TaskRevision or ContextVersion mutation
acceptanceSignals: metric registry and report schemas pass structural and semantic validation
successRate, stableSuccessRate, hardViolationRate, meanLatency, and recoveryRate are deterministically derived from verified platform records
claimOverstatementRate and meanCost remain evidence-pending until an authoritative registered source is supplied
humanCorrectionRate closes only for tasks with a platform-reverified task-bound correction observation; tasks without one remain outside its denominator
regressionPassRate closes only from task-scoped OutcomeAssertions produced by the registered platform.static-replay-v1 verifier, otherwise it remains evidence-pending/null
tampered EvaluationRecord, broken event chain, duplicate TaskId, scope expansion, forged registry hash, and false-zero telemetry are rejected
direct PowerShell 5.1 test entrypoints run without requiring callers to supply paths solely to initialize PSScriptRoot
strict UTF-8 and target diff checks pass
counterexamples: an empty task cohort reports 100 percent success
one accepted task is reported as stable success
missing correction telemetry reports humanCorrectionRate equals zero
a tampered EvaluationRecord participates in a commercial report
an Automation Accepted run increments successRate
a task-scoped hard failure becomes a project-global P0
report generation changes TaskRevision or ContextVersion
the same source snapshot produces different metric values
nonGoals: Unity, Worker, network, or Release execution
inventing cost, correction, claim-audit, or regression facts from chat text
combining unrelated domain scores into one ES quality score
assumptions: TaskContext event chains and EvaluationRecords are available under a project-relative StoreRoot
PowerShell 5.1 or later is available for the platform-neutral static implementation
stable success requires at least two task observations for the same frozen GoalRevision hash
sourceRefs: current user objective: commercial-grade controllable AI collaboration platform

recovery.resumeAction: Re-read the selected TaskContext event chains and EvaluationRecords, discard the uncommitted report, and regenerate from the current verified snapshot.
recovery.partialStatePolicy: Fail the report on tamper or identity mismatch; keep individual unavailable metrics evidence-pending without mutating source tasks.
